fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.entry-content > div.content-inner since the ld+json @graph has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, WordPress /feed/) carry title/link-style fields, including a full-text content:encoded passthrough.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the ld+json Article node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description (article mode: <meta name="description">, falls back to the ld+json WebPage node's description; latest mode: RSS teaser text).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text. Article mode: joined from direct-child

tags of div.entry-content > div.content-inner. Latest mode: flattened plain text from the RSS item's content:encoded full-text field.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name, from the ld+json Article node's inline author object (article mode) or the RSS dc:creator (latest mode -- a real per-article byline, not a placeholder).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name ("Leadership Newspapers"), resolved from the ld+json publisher @id reference to its Organization node (article mode only).

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section name from the ld+json Article node, e.g. "News", "Business" (article mode only; always a single string on this site).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tag from the ld+json Article node, when present (article mode only; not every article has one).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, resolved from the ld+json Article node's image @id reference to its ImageObject node (article mode only; this site has no thumbnailUrl field).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

content.title: Content (raw HTML)
content.description: Full article HTML from the RSS item's <content:encoded> field (latest mode only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of <category> values from the RSS item (latest mode only; this feed carries one category per item).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item guid, an internal post ID URL (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
